candidate_assignments.explanation: Using Kaggle Kernels is an environment/setup convenience, not a teachable concept about building neural networks with Keras/TensorFlow.
General definition of TensorFlow is not a lesson-local concept about building neural networks; it does not directly teach network construction.
The computational graph approach is background information not required for hands‑on model building with Keras.
Historical facts about TensorFlow (Google Brain, release years) do not constitute a teachable concept for building neural networks.
DistBelief is an obsolete predecessor; mentioning it is incidental and does not add to a lesson on current Keras/TensorFlow usage.
Design goals like flexibility and portability are marketing aspects, not actionable concepts for constructing neural networks.
The TensorFlow ecosystem (TF.js, Lite, TFX) is too broad; the lesson focuses on core Keras model building, not deployment variants.
TensorBoard is a visualization tool supplementary to model building; it is not a central lesson concept.
TensorFlow Hub pre‑trained models are useful but not a primary concept for a lesson on building custom neural networks with Keras.
Generic ML model definition is a prerequisite, not specific to building neural networks with Keras/TensorFlow in this lesson.
TensorFlow Playground is an exploratory tool; it does not directly teach the construction of neural networks in Keras.
Competitor comparisons (PyTorch, CNTK) are meta‑information that does not help a student build neural networks with Keras/TensorFlow.
Industry applications of TensorFlow are not directly relevant to building neural networks with Keras and TensorFlow.
TensorFlow Quantum is a specialized library not directly related to building standard neural networks.
Career pillars for ML specialist are general advice, not specific to building neural networks with Keras.
TensorFlow certification is administrative, not a teachable concept for this lesson.
Installation package details are setup steps, not core to learning neural network construction.
CPU installation verification is a setup step, not a neural network concept.
GPU installation verification is a setup step, not part of neural network building.
NVIDIA software dependencies are environment configuration, not directly about neural networks.
GPU support by OS is setup information, not part of neural network content.
Miniconda recommendation for Windows is a setup tool, not a core lesson concept.
Microsoft Visual C++ dependency is environment configuration, not about neural networks.
System requirements are prerequisites, not teachable neural network concepts.
Default GPU memory allocation is a low-level detail, not essential for learning to build neural networks.
Configuring fixed GPU memory limits is an operational detail, not a core neural network concept.
Memory growth configuration is a setup detail, not part of neural network building.
Monitoring GPU memory with nvidia-smi is a debugging tool, not a teachable neural network concept.
Profiling GPU usage is an advanced optimization topic, not core to this lesson.

lesson.title: Rede Neural com Keras (Tensorflow)
lesson.description: Os conceitos apresentados sobre redes neurais serão implementados utilizando a API Keras de Python em conjunto com o Tensorflow. Após este encontro, os estudantes deverão ser capazes de implementar Redes Neurais de diversas configurações utilizando as ferramentas apresentadas.
